$comment: Unknown outcome. outcome_unknown means: it is not known whether a transaction was created. It carries no transaction id, is never a failure and is never repeated automatically. When a transaction id IS known, an uncertain step leads to status polling instead (and at worst to pending).

situations.situation: POST /transactions answered 2xx without a transaction id
Status unreadable until the budget ends (id known)

afterOutcomeUnknown: The checkout ends; no further transaction can be created in it.
The payer sees: do not pay again until the shop confirms the order.
The merchant backend reconciles the order by control from SimPay webhooks.
androidToday: No separate result: Failed(Indeterminate, retryable=false) for timeouts, and Failed(TransactionFailed, retryable=true) for the other cases above (P0).
